doc:
Check the peripheral instance of the Becoming core's laws of a level drawn on and not replenished in
formation beyond renewal.

`RenewingCorrespondence` imports `Becoming.Stock` and `RenewingFormation` (with `GenerativeComparison`,
which use Lean's standard library and its tactics), so it is compiled with Lean 4.30.0-rc2, as the other
instance modules are, with the installed Mathlib on the path (`SYSTEMS_MATHLIB_PROJECT`, default
`~/repos/生生不息`), though it imports none. This checker follows `check_continuation_correspondence.py`:
module resolution, declaration scanning and passed-receipt matching are those of the core checker, and
every other module in the closure must match a passed receipt. Each declaration's axiom report is
recorded: it may name only the standard axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), and the
declarations in EMPTY must have empty reports. The core does not import this module. Lean steps are
reused as in the core checker, keyed also by the Mathlib revision; `BECOMING_FRESH=1` runs every step.
The run folder keeps the receipt, the drivers and logs of the steps that ran, and a copy of each file
`main` does not hold byte for byte.
scope: On the Becoming core's laws of a level drawn on and not replenished: in RenewingFormation, steps beyond the current renewal rate are the moves of one process recording the pressure and what forms; across each the budget (held conditions plus the triangular renewal bound) falls by at least what forms and something forms wherever it is positive (budget_falls, forms_while_held, from beyond_step). The first n steps of a course beyond the current rate are a trace drawing in all what formed (path_trace, total_moves), so by Stock.trace_falls the whole-unfolding total is bounded by the budget (beyond_current_bounded_by_core), by Stock.exhausted_within and Stock.draws_nothing_from_empty nothing forms from the time equal to the budget (beyond_current_ceases_by_core), and every allocation of that formation, shared formation included, ends with it (shared_formation_ends_by_core). The wear law and the representation of formation keep the earlier modules' scope; which real processes satisfy the law is not checked.
